- 60m system-design (day 2) and 45m coding/operational deep-dive (day 2).
- Product slot can be 40m to allow a short break between panels.

- Day 2: systems design (Jordan) -> coding/ops (TBD). If Jordan can lead systems, we can surface architecture tradeoffs early.

3) Scribe & debrief
- I recommend a 15m immediate debrief after day 2 (post-coding) with interviewing panelists plus the hiring manager and a scribe. We should reserve a short buffer for a quick score calibration.

4) Interviewer constraints
- Laura: available Wed 27 10:30–13:30 (PT) — prefers product-first questions; can do 40m slot.
- Jordan: can take systems on Wed 27 from 11:30–13:30 (PT).
- I'll own behavioral on Tue 26 morning (09:00–09:45 PT).
